newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH NBP SELLS PLN 990 MLN OF ITS BILLS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH NBP SELLS PLN 990 MLN OF ITS BILLS.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland sold 500 million zlotys of its 182-day NBP-bills and 490 million zlotys of 273-day bills against the central bank's one billion zloty offer, the NBP said.

It said the average yield for 182-day paper was 19.61 percent, down from 19.75 percent at the last auction on August 16 and an average yield of 19.35 percent for comparable 26-week T-bill sold at the last primary auction on Monday.
The average yield of the 273-day paper was 19.74 percent, down from 19.84 percent at the last auction and 20.30 percent for comparable 39-week T-bill, last sold on July 8.
